Jo (People Ops): Heads-up: EmeraldTrust sent a notice about sunsetting our legacy retirement plan product. Effective date listed 2024-05-20. Anyone on benefits loop seen the intake spec?
Ravi (Payroll): I saw it this morning. They want a successor trustee mapping and a batch CSV. Payroll needs final mapping at least 72 hours before the pay cutoff to avoid off-cycle.
Maya (Benefits): Packet in vendor portal. Required CSV fields: `last4,dob,plan_code,pre_tax,after_tax,catchup,loan_id,loan_balance`. They also require a signed consent per participant for trustee-to-trustee transfer.
Jo (People Ops): Two immediate concerns: 1) loan repayments mid-amortization becoming taxable distributions if not rolled, 2) catch-up contributors (50+) — how to handle continuity.
Ian (Legal): Taxable distributions are a real risk. I'll review the Emerald agreement for notice obligations; if they shortened notice we can push the effective date. Also ok with central collection of consents if we capture explicit authorization and retention policy.
Ravi (Payroll): Practical note: pay dates around that period are 2024-05-17 and 2024-05-31. If Emerald processes 05/20 we probably need to remap for the 05/31 run; final CSV ideally by 05/28 COB.
Maya (Benefits): Successor trustee (Harborline) replied: accepts e-sign for consents and trustee-to-trustee loan rollovers if loan_id matches. They requested DOB + last4 for matching. They still require the signed consent PDF per participant.
Jo (People Ops): Proposed actions: A) Freeze voluntary deferral edits to Emerald plan until mapping complete. B) Benefits export a redacted participant ledger and loan ledger. C) Decide central vs self-managed signature collection. D) Draft urgent employee note: "Do not change elections for Emerald plan until we confirm transfers."
Ravi (Payroll): I'll export a redacted sample tonight for benefits/legal to review. Example (redacted):
```
emp_id,last4,pre_tax,catchup,loan_id,loan_balance
60011,3344,500,true,L-442,5200
60077,8899,0,false,,0
60122,5566,200,false,,0
```
Maya (Benefits): Central collection preferred to speed transfers. Harborline accepts zipped batch uploads named by emp_id and a CSV mapping. I'll confirm exact filename format.
Ian (Legal): Draft consent blurb: "I authorize Redwood Inference to transmit identifying information and effect a trustee-to-trustee transfer of my retirement account to the successor trustee. I acknowledge certain in-plan Roth conversions or loan terms may require special handling and could be treated as distributions if ineligible for rollover." We'll need checkbox consent and 7-year retention.
Jo (People Ops): Deadlines: Maya confirm Harborline intake + e-sign acceptance by 2pm; Ravi post redacted export by 1pm; Ian finalize consent text by 3pm. I'll draft the urgent note after those pieces.
LedgerBot: Task created: emerald-transition-1712345600 assigned to @Maya @Ravi @Jo @Ian.
Ravi (Payroll): Export posted to Shared/Benefits/Emerald-Transition/ (redacted). I flagged 52 catch-up contributors and 19 active loans.
Maya (Benefits): Uploaded draft FAQ and the trustee intake spec to the shared folder. FAQ will cover loans, Roth conversions, international tax, and how to sign/upload consent.
Jo (People Ops): Thanks team. One final ask: Maya, flag any employees with recent in-plan Roth conversions — we need special messaging. Also add international note for UK/Canada.
Maya (Benefits): Will do. I have 6 employees with Roth conversions in the last 12 months; I'll add a Q&A line.
Jo (People Ops): Great. I'll keep this thread as the canonical log and send a leadership update after 3pm. :thumbsup:
